title: Acaia Brew Session Beverage Mass Leaderboard
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=acaia:brew beverage_mass_g=*
| stats sum(beverage_mass_g) as total_value, avg(beverage_mass_g) as avg_value by profile_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks profile name values by total and average beverage mass across Acaia brew session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `beverage_mass_g` values for each Acaia brew session event and review total and average beverage mass by profile name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total beverage mass.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which profile name shows the biggest beverage mass numbers in your Acaia brew session data.
